headline: Metro 1.8.0 is live. Station names and dates are set in Metro Sign Sans: Encode Sans (SIL OFL 1.1) at width 112.5, the closest free face to Jiří Rathouský's Metron, self-hosted as one 28 KB woff2. Every HTML text size is now on taste.md's steps (13/17/20), with nothing under 13 px. Pavol approved the move on 2026-11-05.

shipped.title: Metro 1.8.0: station names and dates in Metro Sign Sans (closest free face to Rathouský's Metron), four type steps
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-05 at 390 px on https://metro.dravec.org/?date=1988-10-26&station=dejvicka. The only font request is same-origin (/fonts/metro-sign-sans.woff2: 200, font/woff2, 28,208 bytes). document.fonts reports 'Metro Sign Sans' loaded. The date label and detail heading are in the face, and the heading is 20 px. /fonts/OFL.txt is served. The speed select is 44 px tall, and scrollWidth is 390.

font.name: Metro Sign Sans (a modified Encode Sans)
font.source: Encode Sans by The Encode Project Authors (Impallari, Torresi, Le Bailly), google/fonts ofl/encodesans, EncodeSans[wdth,wght].ttf, sha256 7735320a…beb43f
font.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1. The OFL reserves the name 'Encode Sans', so the subset is renamed. The copyright, trademark and licence notices are kept, and public/fonts/OFL.txt ships with it.
font.why_closest: Metron (Rathouský, DPP commission 1970, Metroprojekt manual 1973, lines A and C) is a commercial Storm Type family. I set eight free faces beside its specimen. Encode Sans at width 112.5 matched on squarish rounded bowls, straight-cut terminals, open apertures, a splayed M and a similar width. Titillium Web and Barlow are too condensed. Saira and Exo 2 are too technical. Fira Sans, Ubuntu and Signika are too calligraphic.
font.weight: 28,208 bytes: one variable woff2, weights 400–700, Latin and Latin Extended-A (all Czech letters). The test budget is ≤ 60 KB.

decisions.question: Which elements get the signage face?
options: Station names and dates only, with prose in the system face
decisions.default_taken: Names and dates: the map labels, tooltip and detail headings, the date label, the small-multiple years, event dates, and in the history tables the dates, the sections' station names, the station list's names and its names until 1990.
decisions.why: That is the brief, and it is how signage works: names and times are set in the sign face, and the explanatory text is not.

decisions.question: Apply the four steps to the sidebar only, or to the whole page?
options: Whole page outside the map's SVG
decisions.default_taken: Whole page: the header, controls, legend, tooltip and banner too. The map's SVG labels scale with the map, are hidden at 820 px and below, and are left out of the check.
decisions.why: Same rule, and the same sub-13 px sizes were in the header and controls. A test checks it at 390 px and on desktop.

decisions.question: Secondary event text: Label step in capitals, or 13/18 in sentence case?
decisions.default_taken: 13/18 sentence case. The tabs and line tags use the uppercase tracked Label.
decisions.why: A sentence set in capitals reads worse. The size stays on the scale.

decisions.question: The wider date face made the date label change width between months, which moved the slider during Play. What to do?
decisions.default_taken: min-width 172 px. A test checks that the label width and the slider position are the same in May as in September.
decisions.why: The full e2e suite caught the movement. A fixed width fixes it without shrinking the date.

decisions.question: 'Light and dark': add a light theme?
options: No; the page stays dark under both colour-scheme preferences
decisions.default_taken: No light theme. Before and after screenshots were taken under both preferences, and a test loads both and checks the ground and the 390 px width.
decisions.why: White on dark is the signage, and SIGNATURE.md says 'keep the dark ground'. A light theme would change what the product looks like.

decisions.question: Font budget
decisions.why: No budget was written down anywhere, so I set one and recorded it here.

decisions.question: Independent review findings
decisions.why: Each fix is small and tested. Locally: e2e 70/70, vitest 16/16, typecheck and build pass. CI was green on the merged head.
